sections.title: What's New
items: A new Software Update app takes over updates: it shows your build at the top, has a Check for updates button, and in its Settings you choose whether updates install by themselves overnight while your tablet charges.
Use a USB webcam for video calls: plug one into your tablet and apps such as Google Meet and Zoom can use it.
The Daylight Store comes built in, so you can install and update Daylight apps from it.

sections.title: Improvements
items: The screen's refresh rate now stays between 45 Hz and 90 Hz, as on Daylight's newest software, so scrolling and animations look smoother; you can still change it under Smooth display in Settings.
